name: Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.
descriptionMd: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &amp;quot;Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana&amp;quot; for unorganized worker on 05 June 2018. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing required equipment/items.
eligibilityMd:
1. Applicant women should be registered in any district of the state.
1. If applicant received from any other parallel scheme of the State Government, then applicant is not eligible for this scheme.
1. Beneficiaries aged between 18 years to 60 years will be eligible under the scheme.
